name: Edgerton
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Edgerton, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Edgerton, Wisconsin for 2026: a lighted parade, Santa visits, a drive-through light display and library crafts.
lede: Edgerton packs its Christmas into Home for the Holidays, a downtown day of parade, tree lighting and crafts, then adds Santa visits at the hospital, the coffee shop and a bait shop plus a free drive-through light display.
celebrates: Visit Edgerton, the town's tourism office, describes Home for the Holidays as free activities for the whole family throughout downtown, with a lighted parade and a community tree lighting as the evening finish. The Lights of Central Park add a drive-through display that families can see at their own pace, and the Sterling North Home and Museum opens its barn for a free ornament-making activity. Local businesses fill out the season with Santa photos, a coffee shop visit with Buddy the Elf and a hospital breakfast, so the town offers something for babies, school-age kids and grandparents.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Edgerton's holiday events. The tourism office's own pages describe the same pattern each year: a parade followed by a tree lighting downtown, a museum open house with a free barn craft and a drive-through lights display in Central Park. Earlier Home for the Holidays posts from the organizers also describe staying after the lighted parade for the lighting of the holiday tree downtown.
facts: The Sterling North Home and Museum sits at 409 West Rollin Street, and Visit Edgerton lists its holiday open house with shopping and a free ornament craft in the museum barn. Central Park, home of the lights display, is at 310 North Main Street, according to the tourism office's event listing. Edgerton Public Library sits at 10 Albion Street and runs its own holiday crafts and cookie decorating for families.
trains: Edgerton does not have its own Christmas train. The closest holiday trains in this guide are at the East Troy Railroad Museum, which runs daytime and evening Christmas trains and a free Santa Parade Train. Edgerton families can combine a lights drive in Central Park with a train weekend in East Troy.

faq: Edgerton celebrates with Home for the Holidays, a downtown day of free family activities that includes a lighted parade and a tree lighting. The Lights of Central Park provide a drive-through display, the Sterling North Museum offers a free ornament craft, and several local hosts bring Santa to town for photos and treats.

Many are. Visit Edgerton lists the parade, the tree lighting, the Lights of Central Park and the museum ornament craft as free. Some Santa visits and library programs do not print a price, so check each host before you go.
Is there a Christmas parade in Edgerton?

Yes. The Home for the Holidays Lighted Parade runs through downtown Edgerton in the evening, and the community tree lighting follows. The tourism office lists the parade as a free event for the whole family.
Where can kids meet Santa in Edgerton?

Local hosts bring Santa to Edgerton Hospital for breakfast, to The Coffee Depot with Buddy the Elf, to Dam Paradise bait shop and to a downtown consignment shop for photos. Each has its own date and hours, listed on this page.
What can families do at the Lights of Central Park?
The display is a drive-through light show at Edgerton's Central Park. Families stay in the car, so it works for babies and for children who tire in cold weather, and it is free.
